title: Machine learning models integrating 2D and 3D intratumoral heterogeneity features from multi-sequence MRI: accurate prediction of perineural invasion in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
summary: 205 pathologically confirmed PDAC patients; train 100, internal test 43, external cohorts 28 and 34; fixed threshold applied without re-optimization. Learned multi-sequence 2D/3D MRI features predict perineural invasion; external model metrics are reported in Results tables. Published in Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence.
ai_technology: Radiomics/ML predicts pathology-confirmed PNI in independent external cohorts; retrospective diagnostic performance, not prospective treatment benefit.
